summary: Standard Lithium Ltd. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release from its joint venture, Smackover Lithium, announcing the award of an EPCC contract for the South West Arkansas Project's Central Processing Facility. The contract with S B Engineers and Constructors covers ~2/3 of project capex and includes a limited notice to proceed for pre-FID work. No acquisition, divestiture, capital return, restructuring, or other special-situation event is disclosed. The filing is a routine project development update, not a special situation.
